parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the API group. This ID is generated by the system and globally unique.

parameters.name: HistoryVersion
parameters.description: Specifies the version number that you want to query.

parameters.name: StageName
parameters.description:
The name of the runtime environment. Valid values:

*   **RELEASE**
*   **TEST**: the test environment
*   **PRE**: the pre-release environment

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi describe-api-history --group-id 3013a55c0c44483f984d26df27120513 --api-id dc6e17ee3120404c839bbcd7622ab6ed --stage-name RELEASE --history-version 20211122155403834 --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
